queries.result: Search found the official Hotan Prefecture Natural Resources Bureau remit and an official Hotan procurement notice describing cadastral-database and registration-system integration. Neither exposes a public anonymous parcel geometry service.

officialLeads.evidence: Official agency page assigns natural-resources surveying, mapping/geographic-information management, and supervision/guidance of natural-resource and real-estate title registration to the prefectural bureau. This is a custodian lead, not proof of a public parcel feed.

Official procurement notice describes Hotan cadastral data covering residential, collective, state-owned construction/agricultural land and other rights, with transfer into registration systems; it does not publish a query endpoint or geometry.

Public portal was reachable. Its HTML loads a public configuration and map application; the inspected configuration exposes public basemap/service URLs and a platform map route, but no Hotan cadastral layer or anonymous parcel feature service.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Natural Resources information-disclosure listing reachable; no parcel endpoint exposed.
Current public JavaScript configuration inspected; public map, WMTS and platform URLs found, but no parcel/cadastral service or schema.
Current public map HTML and JavaScript inspected; application supports generic service layers but no Hotan parcel layer was identified.
National registration portal was not queried further; no TLS bypass, login, or identity workflow was attempted.

blocker: No public anonymous Hotan parcel service or bounded ID-plus-geometry response was verified. Packet completion records research only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
remainingUncertainty: A local or prefectural viewer may exist behind an unindexed route, an ordinary public bootstrap, or a later platform release. No credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe lookup was used.
nextStep: Retry any publicly linked Hotan natural-resources or registration viewer when a public route is identified, then validate target-city scope, schema, CRS, stable native IDs, and a small safe geometry response before admission.
